primary_text: "What are the actual total costs? Stamp duty, council rates, body corp — it adds up fast." Other business owners asked the same thing before buying their Truganina warehouse. Here's what they found: when all costs are laid out transparently, the total is often more affordable than years of rising rent. We provide a complete cost breakdown including stamp duty, body corporate, council rates, and legal fees. No hidden extras. Purpose-built warehouses near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. See the real numbers for yourself.
